Arrow added (section 4, pass 3), move sequencing: A20 P01 -> P20, order, strength strong. Connection: in a room carrying both, the first call to the canvas comes before the first line the host sub draws around canvas talk (a megathread, a removal by rule, a changed rule, a canvas sub, an objection to the flood, a dismissal of the canvas). Holds in 132 of 155 rooms (0.852) against a null mean of 0.538 (p95 0.594); early 48 of 57, late 2 of 2. Mechanism: Calls to the canvas flood the host sub, and its moderators or members answer by drawing a line around canvas talk: one thread, removals, a canvas sub. Fails if: In a room, the line comes before any call, or the line's words name no canvas flood. Sampled against: transformers holds (the first line (h80.40) is a member's judgment of the canvas's worth after the close; it names no flood, so the mechanism is not shown here); darksouls holds (the first line removes separate canvas posts into a megathread (h53.56)); crusaderkings holds (the first line opens a canvas sub to leave the messy comment section (h9.41)); rotmg holds (the first line asks to gather the scattered canvas posts into one megathread (h72.02)). Bound: Partly constitutive: a removal by rule needs a post to remove, and an objection to the flood needs canvas posts. 23 of 155 rooms draw the line first: the sub's automatic rules remove the first call as it is posted (9 rooms, three in the same hour), a canvas sub or a megathread is set up before the host sub carries any call (7), or members dismiss the canvas or object to other rooms' canvas posts before the room calls (7).

Counterexample response: Pass 3: guatemala and MiamiHurricanes, read at pass 2, are one late room and one room moved by a coalition. Alternatives considered: withdrawing the arrow, or a second element for a planned move. Response: two scope conditions; A10 stays thin. The old line is kept as was in model/history.jsonl.
